official.deadline_note: National nominating agencies may set their own earlier closing dates and will nominate candidates to the CSC by December 2026.
official.status_note: Official pages state applications for the 2027/28 academic year are now open for both Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships, closing 16:00 BST on Tuesday 20 October; the Split-site PhD programme is currently paused and will not be running in 2026 or 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Approved tuition fees: full fees are covered by agreement between the CSC and the UK university, and Scholars are not liable to pay for any part of the tuition fee.
benefits: Approved tuition fees: full fees are covered by agreement between the CSC and the UK university, and Scholars are not liable to pay for any part of the tuition fee
Stipend (living allowance) at the rate of £1,712 per month, or £2,000 per month for those at universities in the London metropolitan area (rates quoted at current levels)
Approved airfare from the Scholar's home country to the UK and return at the end of the award (dependants' fares are not reimbursed)
Study travel grant towards the cost of study-related travel within the UK or overseas
PhD only: provision towards the cost of overseas fieldwork (one economy class return airfare) where approved, and a paid mid-term visit to the Scholar's home country
Child allowance of £622 per month for the first child and £154 per month for the second and third child under 16, for Scholars who are widowed, divorced, or single parents
eligibility: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country, or be a British Protected Person, and be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country

Be available to start academic studies in the UK by September 2027 and hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard, or a lower second-class degree plus a relevant postgraduate qualification, by September 2027
Be unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship
Have provided all supporting documentation in the required format
Master's applicants must not have already studied at Master's level at a UK institution or already received a Commonwealth Scholarship at Master's level
PhD applicants must not be registered for a PhD, or an MPhil leading to a PhD, before September/October 2026
requirements: Apply online via the CSC Central application system - the CSC is unable to accept any applications or documentation not submitted via CSC Central
Apply to a nominator: national nominating agencies (the main route) or selected non-governmental organisations and charitable bodies; the CSC does not accept direct applications
Apply for admission to preferred UK universities in advance of the scholarship application
Make clear in the application which qualification is being applied for
List three universities and courses (Master's) or universities and supervisors (PhD) in order of preference
Provide a Development Impact statement in four parts and a detailed plan of study in the application form
documents: Proof that they are a citizen or have refugee status in an eligible Commonwealth country: a copy of a valid passport (or national ID card) showing a photograph, date of birth, and country of citizenship
Full transcripts detailing all higher education qualifications, including to-date transcripts for any courses currently being studied, with certified translations if not in English
References from at least two individuals, in PDF format, signed and either on institutional letterhead or an email clearly showing the sender's details
PhD applicants: a supporting statement from a proposed supervisor in the UK from at least one of the institutions named on the application form
A Health and Disability Form before the Confirmation of Award can be issued
selection_criteria: Potential impact on the development of the candidate's home country
coverage: Approved tuition fees in full, covered by agreement between the CSC and the UK university
Monthly stipend (living allowance) of £1,712 per month, or £2,000 per month for those at universities in the London metropolitan area
Approved airfare from the Scholar's home country to the UK and return at the end of the award
Study travel grant towards the cost of study-related travel within the UK or overseas
PhD only: provision towards the cost of fieldwork undertaken overseas (one economy class return airfare to the fieldwork location), where approved
application_method: Register and complete the online application on CSC Central, the only accepted application route
Apply through a national nominating agency (main route) or a selected NGO/charitable body nominator, observing the nominator's own closing date
Upload all required supporting documentation to CSC Central by the deadline; documentation submitted outside the system is not accepted
Apply for admission to chosen UK universities alongside the scholarship application; selections are made from the pool of nominations after December 2026
official.application_route: Apply online via CSC Central and through a national nominating agency (main route) or selected NGO/charitable body; direct applications to the CSC are not accepted.
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a citizen of, or have been granted refugee status by, an eligible Commonwealth country, or a British Protected Person, and be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - designed for applicants from eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries (Master's) and least developed countries and vulnerable states as classified by the OECD DAC (PhD); Master's eligible countries include India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Kenya, Ghana, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia and others; PhD eligible countries include Bangladesh, The Gambia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia and others.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any subject aligned with the six CSC development themes; the CSC does not provide new direct financial or promotional support for the fossil fuel energy sector; Master's: one-year taught programmes only, no MBA degrees.
official.research_requirement: Master's: a detailed plan of study and a four-part Development Impact statement in the application form. PhD: quality of research proposal is a selection criterion, and a supporting statement from a proposed UK supervisor at one of the listed institutions is required.
official.duration: Master's: one-year taught programme (12 months). PhD: 36 months of full-time study; four-year PhDs are not supported.
official.description: Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO), Commonwealth Master's Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development and are aimed at those who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK. Commonwealth PhD Scholarships contribute to the development needs of Commonwealth countries by supporting research that will have a developmental impact, for applicants from least developed countries and vulnerable states. Both are offered under the six CSC development themes and are tenable at approved UK universities with a CSC part-funding agreement.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK)
official.english_requirement: The CSC does not require any candidates to take an IELTS (English language) test.

applicant_utility.summary: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission's Master's and PhD awards cover full UK tuition, a £1,712 monthly stipend (£2,000 in the London area), approved return airfare, and a study travel grant, but you cannot apply to the CSC directly - your application must go through a national nominating agency whose own deadline usually falls earlier than the CSC's 16:00 BST 20 October 2026 cutoff. Applications for 2027/28 entry are currently open, with selection drawn from nominator pools in December 2026 and outcomes emailed by July 2027. If your country is on the eligible list, work backwards from your nominator's deadline to gather complete transcripts and referee letters, because incomplete documentation makes the application ineligible on formal grounds rather than merely weaker. No IELTS is required by the CSC itself, but you still need to secure university admission in parallel, and that is where English requirements actually bite.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career professionals and researchers from eligible Commonwealth countries (PhD: least developed countries and vulnerable states) with a 2:1 first degree and a concrete, evidence-backed story of development impact in their home country.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country appears on the eligible-country list for the exact programme you want - the Master's list and the PhD list are different
Identify your national nominating agency and submit through its process by its own deadline, which is typically earlier than 20 October 2026
Collect full transcripts covering every page of every higher-education qualification, with certified translations, plus to-date transcripts for any course still in progress
Brief at least two referees early so signed, PDF letters on institutional letterhead (or email clearly showing sender details) are ready before the deadline
PhD applicants: obtain a supporting statement from a proposed supervisor at one of your listed UK universities
Draft answers offline using the CSC template application form and guidance document, then register on CSC Central with two-factor authentication ready (smartphone or second email account)
Apply for admission to your chosen UK universities in advance and list three realistic course or supervisor choices in strict order of preference
Submit well before 16:00 BST on 20 October 2026 - the CSC warns the system is very busy near the deadline and late applications cannot be accepted
common_rejection_risks: Missing or partial transcripts - any qualification omitted, any page missing, or any missing certified translation makes the application ineligible outright
Applying directly to the CSC instead of through a nominator; the CSC does not accept direct applications
References or (for PhD) supervisor supporting statements not uploaded into CSC Central by the deadline; late documents are refused
Assuming no English test is needed at all - universities set their own admission requirements, so a missing IELTS/TOEFL for admission can silently sink the scholarship placement
Listing fewer than three university/course choices or choices the CSC cannot place you at; the CSC will not change preferences after selection and the scholarship cannot proceed
Master's applicants who already studied at Master's level in the UK or already held a Commonwealth Master's Scholarship, or who apply for a second Master's without justification
PhD applicants already registered for a PhD or MPhil before September/October 2026, or whose proposed research sits in the fossil-fuel energy sector the CSC does not fund
Not responding promptly to the outcome email - a scholarship offer may be withdrawn if the candidate does not reply within the specified time
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: UK student visa fees and the immigration health surcharge, dependants' travel (explicitly not reimbursed), family maintenance beyond the CSC's contribution allowances - the CSC states true costs are likely considerably higher and Scholars must supplement them - and any personal spending beyond the monthly stipend, study travel grant, and approved fares.
document_audit: Transcripts must include every page of every qualification; a missing page is an ineligibility trigger, not a gap you can fix after submission
Referees must write in their own words, sign, and use institutional letterhead or an email clearly showing their details, uploaded as PDF
CSC Central uses two-factor authentication at every login; keep the Application Reference Number email (format 01234-SSP-UK-15) and the 22-character passcode safe
Refreshing the browser window exits the form and loses unsaved data, and applications cannot be edited after submission - draft offline, save often
Applications may not be edited after submitting, so double-check the qualification you are applying for; unclear applications can be deemed ineligible
alerts: Nominator deadlines precede the CSC's 20 October 2026 cutoff and nominators only forward nominations to the CSC by December 2026 - missing the agency deadline ends the bid for this cycle
All Commonwealth Scholars must return home after the award; switching to a Graduate or other visa to remain in the UK is not permitted
Split-site PhD Scholarships are currently paused and will not be running in 2026 or 2027 - do not plan around that route this cycle
Outcomes are emailed by July 2027; monitor all folders including spam, because failure to respond in time can void an offer
A Commonwealth Scholarship cannot be held concurrently with another award covering the same costs, and it cannot be offered if it breaches the terms of a previously held scholarship
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to your national nominating agency by its own deadline and separately submit the full CSC Central application with all documents uploaded; the agency nominates its shortlist to the CSC by December 2026 and the CSC selects from the pooled nominations.
